t.zh: 冰面会打滑。这一关机器人只往右或往下走，可每走一步，都有 20% 的可能滑向另一个方向：想往右，可能滑到下面；想往下，可能滑到右边。
t.en: Ice is slippery. In this level the robot moves only right or down, but every step has a 20% chance of sliding the other way: aiming right, it may slide down; aiming down, it may slide right.

t.zh: 地图最下一行和最右一列是悬崖（−10），宝藏就在悬崖边上。
t.en: The bottom row and right-hand column of the map are cliffs (−10), and the treasure sits right at the cliff edge.

t.zh: 结果不确定时，一个动作的价值，是几种结果按可能性加权：往右 = 0.8 × 右边 + 0.2 × 下面。两个动作挑好的那个，再打九折。
t.en: When the outcome is uncertain, an action’s value is its outcomes weighted by how likely they are: going right = 0.8 × right + 0.2 × down. Pick the better of the two actions, then discount by 10%.

t.zh: 电路会比较大。小窍门：一个常数可以同时接给好几个乘法器。
t.en: The circuit will be fairly big. A tip: one Constant can be wired into several Multipliers at once.

goal.zh: 只往右或往下走，每一步有 20% 的可能滑向另一个方向。每一格的价值 = 0.9 × 两个动作里较好的那个；往右 = 0.8 × 右边 + 0.2 × 下面，往下 = 0.8 × 下面 + 0.2 × 右边。
goal.en: Move only right or down; every step has a 20% chance of sliding the other way. Each cell’s value = 0.9 × the better of the two actions; going right = 0.8 × right + 0.2 × down, going down = 0.8 × down + 0.2 × right.

how.zh: 这一关会检查整张表。通过后，每一格会长出最好动作的箭头。
how.en: This level checks the whole table. Once you pass, each cell grows an arrow for its best action.

body.zh: 会滑倒，悬崖边的格子就都「变差」了：明明离宝藏只差一步，可往右一走，有 20% 的可能掉下悬崖。看看箭头：贴着悬崖时，机器人宁可选那个滑倒也不要紧的方向。
body.en: Because the robot can slip, every cell along the cliff edge gets “worse”: it may be one step from the treasure, but going right carries a 20% chance of falling off. Look at the arrows: hugging the cliff, the robot prefers the direction where a slip does no harm.

body.zh: 把每种结果按可能性加权，叫作。带着不确定性一步步做决定的问题，叫马尔可夫决策过程，它是强化学习的数学骨架。
body.en: Weighting each outcome by how likely it is gives the . Making decisions step by step under uncertainty is called a Markov decision process, the mathematical skeleton of reinforcement learning.

note.zh: 结果不确定时，一个动作的价值 = 每种结果按可能性加权。
note.en: When the outcome is uncertain, an action’s value = each outcome weighted by how likely it is.

hints.zh: 往右这个动作：0.8 × 右边 + 0.2 × 下面。两个乘法器，一个加法器。
hints.en: The “go right” action: 0.8 × right + 0.2 × down. Two Multipliers and an Adder.

hints.zh: 往下这个动作：0.8 × 下面 + 0.2 × 右边。

hints.en: Take the larger of the two actions, then multiply by 0.9.
